description:
Frozen Spring Boot 2.3.12/javax/Tomcat 9 autoconfiguration line, kept for teams not yet on Boot 3.
    Depends exclusively on the "-legacy" siblings (crnk-setup-servlet-legacy, crnk-data-jpa-legacy,
    crnk-validation-legacy) for anything jakarta-migrated in the mainline - never on the jakarta-based
    modules directly, since Spring Boot 2.3.12/Tomcat 9 cannot load jakarta.* classes. Not actively
    migrated or maintained beyond keeping it compiling - see crnk-setup-spring-boot3 for the supported
    Spring Boot 3/jakarta integration.
